title: Move an openapi-react-query project
prompt: Move this project from openapi-typescript, openapi-fetch and openapi-react-query to openapi-typesafe, openapi-typesafe-fetch and openapi-typesafe-react-query (package.json, scripts and imports). The new packages are installed; do not run an install. `createApi` in `src/api/react.ts` must keep working.
